function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Reschedules an existing appointment to a new slot.

phone.description: The patient's phone number for verification.
phone.title: Phone

dob.description: The patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format for verification.
dob.title: Dob

old_appointment_date.description: The date of the current appointment they wish to change, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
old_appointment_date.title: Old Appointment Date

new_slot_id.description: The new slot ID to move the appointment to.
new_slot_id.title: New Slot Id
